## New
- Read and edit settings: right-click a module in the SVT on the Coding page. E-Sys reads its coding from the car and the FDL-Editor opens with it, in one step.
## Better
- The Save window names the file for you every time (vehicle order, SVT, TAL), also the first time.
- The vehicle profile beside the vehicle order fits smaller screens: the code lists keep their height and nothing is cut off.
